heroSummary:
The first day of school for MPS students is Monday, August 10, 2026, and the last day is Tuesday, May 25, 2027. Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, Winter Break for students is December 21–January 4, and Spring Break is March 29–April 2. Students return after Winter Break on January 5.

MPS also has four Asynchronous Learning Days. Students work remotely on those days while teachers report to school.

calendarFaqs.q: Are MPS Asynchronous Learning Days school holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. They are instructional days, but students work remotely instead of attending school in person.

calendarFaqs.q: When do MPS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Student Winter Break runs December 21–January 4; teachers' break ends January 1, and January 4 is a professional development day for teachers.

calendarFaqs.q: Does MPS have a week-long Fall Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: No week-long Fall Break is listed. MPS closes for Indigenous Peoples Day on Monday, October 12, and students return Tuesday, October 13. The Vacation Planner shows October 10–12 as a three-day planning window because it includes the weekend.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 23, 2026 against the current four-page MPS Academic Calendar, the official Back to School Guide, and the district's Board approval announcement.
sourceReviewDetails: The copy reviewed for this page matches the current four-page PDF published by MPS.
All four pages were reviewed: pages 1–2 contain the dated calendar, page 3 is the MPS Vacation Planner, and page 4 contains the color-coded month grids, legend and annual totals.
Quarter and annual student and teacher totals were checked against the color-coded calendar.
Asynchronous learning dates were checked against both the dated list and the month view.
Vacation Planner windows were compared with the official weekday closures so adjacent weekends were not mistaken for additional no-school days.
Staff-only days, central office closures and program-specific dates were reviewed separately from the districtwide family calendar.
